additional_info.subject: Re: ID0383053-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313518164001] Display off CRM:00642001603
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing good.
we received case from an end customer regarding the display off.
We suggest the following steps for on-site troubleshooting to resolve the issue.
1.
Please reboot the charger.
2. The DP cable needs to be replaced. Use a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part only, no other brands), and ensure it is routed as far away from routers as possible to avoid EMC performance issues, as identified by R&D.
3. Verify the 24VDC power supply is set to 25VDC.
4.
Ensure the cable is properly inserted; remove and reinsert it, then try the screen again.
5.
Test with another USB cable.
6.
Inspect the highlighted connections below for any loose connections or wiring issues.
Please note that if the site is far from your location, we recommend bringing a spare HMI screen in case the troubleshooting steps do not resolve the issue.
Additionally, please notify us two days in advance before scheduling any site intervention. This will allow us to remotely access the charger and offer support if needed.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
